description: Generate the lookalike variants of a domain that could be used to impersonate it, grouped by technique, as a defensive typosquat check. Techniques: omission (missing character), repetition (doubled character), transposition (swapped adjacent), keyboard (QWERTY neighbour), vowel (vowel swap), homoglyph (ASCII lookalikes such as rn for m, vv for w, cl for d, 0 for o, 1 for l), confusable (Cyrillic or Greek letters, shown with the xn-- punycode form), hyphenation, subdomain (prefix and subdomain tricks using the reserved .example ending), and tld (different endings such as .com, .co.uk, .uk, .org, .net, .io, .app, .co). Two-part endings like co.uk are recognised. Each variant carries its punycode (IDNA ASCII) form. The list is deduplicated and capped at 500. No availability, DNS or WHOIS check is made; it only says what could be registered, not what is. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/lookalike-domain-generator/
